lemma tau_interval_finite (Φ : VorticityResponse) (L : TemporalLifting Φ)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    ∃ τ_T : ℝ, L.φ τ_T = T ∧ τ_T ≤ T / Φ.φ_min := by
  obtain ⟨τ_T, hτ_T⟩ := L.φ_surj T hT.le
  refine ⟨τ_T, hτ_T, (le_div_iff₀ Φ.hmin_pos).2 ?_⟩
  rcases le_or_gt τ_T 0 with hτ | hτ
  · nlinarith [Φ.hmin_pos]
  · have := mul_sub_le_image_sub_of_le_deriv L.φ_diff L.φ_deriv_pos hτ.le
    rw [hτ_T, L.φ_zero] at this
    linarith
